name: Plain Milk Chocolate M&M's (Seedless / Nut-Free)
whyItWorks: Plain M&M's have a thin, brittle sugar shell that shatters and dissolves, surrounding a smooth milk chocolate center with zero nuts or seeds. Very low residue.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy a fun-size bag during remission. Let the chocolate melt in your mouth.
watchOuts: Contains milk; limit portion if lactose sensitive.
